assessments.summary: The downstream mathematical audit is sound conditional on the supplied structured transcription being a complete and faithful reproduction of Theorem 9. The 30-row private-message specialization, input-only product marginalization, extended-real value inequalities, Q0 midpoint dependence, nonemptiness, and finiteness are verified for the displayed system. However, the composite claim also requires exact primary-source fidelity, which the bounded evidence does not establish; therefore the overall claim remains indeterminate.
scopeQualifications: The 30-row equivalence is established only between the supplied structured transcription and the independently generated local formulation, not against the unavailable source PDF.
The marginalization proof preserves every term in the supplied exhaustive 3/12/12/3 audit, but its coverage of the entire actual Theorem 9 statement is conditional on transcription completeness.
The inequalities V_Q(G,K) <= V(1/2;G,K) <= B(G,K) hold as extended-real inequalities, including sup(empty set)=-infinity.
Dependence only on (c,g,k,c) establishes well-definedness for (g,k) induced by the admitted finite-output channels.
A Q0-supported zero-rate construction proves nonemptiness, while individual-rate bounds imply 0 <= V_0(g,k) <= 2 for admitted channel pairs.
evidenceIssues: The bytes of GK-outer.pdf were not supplied, so its asserted digest, size, structure, and extracted theorem text cannot be checked.
No governed execution result or signed attestation establishes that the extractor and verifier successfully ran on the asserted PDF bytes.
No allowed independent reference evidence binds the asserted digest to the official author-hosted manuscript.
The expected digest is self-declared in the same contribution and therefore does not independently establish provenance or content.
The verifier does not inspect the embedded PDF creation date despite the README mentioning it.
Taking Theorem 9 as a premise does not discharge the separate obligation to prove that the bounded transcription faithfully reproduces it.
